major.summary: Ambiguous publication failures release the exact-request lock.
major.evidence: publish.onSettled unconditionally clears both dispatch locks while the unresolved frozen publication request remains retained.
major.impact: Competing work can run before exact recovery resolves an irreversible request.
major.recommendation: Release the shared lock only after authoritative success or pre-dispatch Cancel; retain it after ambiguous failure.

minor.summary: ADR-035 still says publication UI is deferred.
minor.evidence: The accepted decision adds publication UI while the deferred paragraph still lists it.
minor.recommendation: Remove publication UI from the deferred list while keeping future publication capabilities deferred.

verification_gaps.summary: Type checking fails on a changed DTO fixture.
verification_gaps.evidence: pnpm types:check reports a draft-inferred object assigned published status.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Construct a correctly typed published fixture and rerun types.

verification_gaps.summary: Formatting and broader gates lack passing evidence.
verification_gaps.evidence: Prettier fails nine files; full tests, ci:check and build have not run.
verification_gaps.recommendation: Format, then run all required gates after repair.

do_not_change: Keep GrowthReportsService.publishGrowthReport and its writer as the sole atomic first-publisher-wins boundary.
Keep publication recovery as an exact coordinate read; do not route it through build recovery's current-period fallback.
Keep publication internal-only: it must not build, regenerate, share, send, or externally expose reports.
